title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with qortex-form
content: qortex-form is framework-agnostic. For React, also install `qortex-form-react`.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: Add the package to your project:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-form@0.1.0-alpha.0

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-form@0.1.0-alpha.0

sections.title: React
sections.content:
For React bindings (`useForm`, `FormProvider`, binders):

```bash
npm install qortex-form-react@0.1.0-alpha.0
```

See [qortex-form-react](/form-react).

sections.title: Requirements
sections.content:
• **Zero runtime dependencies** in core
• **TypeScript** ≥ 4.7 recommended
• Pair with `qortex-query` (or any loader) for fetching — form does not fetch
